intro: Release notes are published from 1.2.13 onward. Earlier 1.2 updates, summarized: Command Center learned to update itself; Return Tasks gained an All checkbox; the Work Items modal became fully keyboard driven; work item detail tabs and the quick filter arrived; the Update button got louder when an update is waiting; tasks can be closed from the dashboard; and the comment, CalcEngine History and Site Scope dialogs received a round of fixes, including the comment modal's input order and default assignee.

releases.theme: Work item links open in your browser
Help that opens where you need it, Work Items that keep up with you, and CalcEngine history you can trust
KAT Command Center is now as beautiful as it is functional.
Your journey towards the dark side is now complete.
Search local folders with Grazer, monitor and manage Git repositories from one place, and work more reliably with Work Items and service authentication.
Find, filter and distinguish repositories, then review file-level changes directly.
A new RBLe Balancer page arrives, and Work Item workflows, release management, Site Scope, Grazer, Repository Status, and shared controls are clearer and easier to use.

Hangfire brings background-job monitoring and management, the Dashboard's tiles (now including Work Items queries) can be ordered and hidden, Site Scope surfaces sites needing attention, and RBLe Balancer adds richer traffic monitoring and host controls.

OE Schedule adds an opt-in enrollment calendar, RBLe Balancer gains CPU history and clearer per-node load, Site Scope gets status filter chips and clearer alerts, and Work Items and Repository Status gain control over What's Happening.
Work Items can share a link that opens a work item straight into KAT Command Center.
Work Items streamlines task collaboration, while Pipeline simplifies release comparisons, commit filtering, and build actions.
